sharedRuntime.target-order: first gc.obbsiteArray entry within distance <= 1200; stable insertion/spawn order
sharedRuntime.target-loss: dead or distance >= 1200 clears target without same-frame reselection
sharedRuntime.follow-owner: without a target, once per frameClips: move toward owner only beyond distance 640, else wait
sharedRuntime.follow-target: outside attack range or failed second normal roll: face target and use shared movement
sharedRuntime.warp: distance from owner >= 1000 and neither attacking nor hurt: root becomes owner.x, owner.y - 30; no warp clip
sharedRuntime.normal-roll: within form attackRange: random <= 0.7 attacks; otherwise a new random < 0.3 waits; otherwise follows target
sharedRuntime.cooldown-order: AI reads current CD first; positive active-pet cooldown slots decrement afterward
sharedRuntime.hurt: reduceHp runs shared defense/hurt/death logic, then horse2..4 arm bd hurtRelease even on the lethal call; death phase wins presentation
sharedRuntime.death: HP <= 0 enters dead action; body frame-over destroys the pet
sharedRuntime.destroy: destroy body/effects and every private bullet, fade/remove after one second, clear only the owning role pet slot and protected references
sharedRuntime.projectile-collision: hero/pet bullets scan monsterArray.concat(likeMonsterArray); complex collision invokes beMagicAttack and optional hit callback
sharedRuntime.attack-id-dedup: bullet snapshots source attackId at setRole; target beAttackIdArray rejects repeats until attackInterval rotates the bullet id
sharedRuntime.damage-pipeline: bullet snapshots getRealPower(action).hurt/qixue plus pet atk * 2.8; target defense/countHurt/reduceHp produces actual HP decrease
sharedRuntime.ice-effect: PETHORSE_ICE adds one PetHorseIceEffect child sized to target collision, stops BBDC, and removes/resumes on expiry
sharedRuntime.p1-p2: single-game or matching sourceRole.sid owns emit/network action; bullets retain source pet/role identity and private lifecycle
